profile.headline: Seasoned Software Engineer | Software Engineer | Veteran | Leadership | Nuclear Engineer Management | Data Science | Machine Learning
profile.summary:
As an experienced United States Navy Nuclear Officer and Surface Warfare Officer with a robust background in software engineering, engineering management, nuclear engineering, and chemistry, I have developed a unique blend of technical, leadership, and management skills that position me for success in technical leadership roles.

During my time in the Navy, I honed my skills in managing large-scale engineering projects, leading high-performing teams, and maintaining complex systems under pressure. As a Nuclear Engineering Plant Supervisor, I gained deep expertise in nuclear plant layout, fluid dynamics, and radioactivity sciences, while managing operations and ensuring safety at all levels. Additionally, I developed a strong command of critical thinking, problem-solving, and personnel management.

Transitioning into the world of software engineering, I built upon my foundation with hands-on experience in backend and frontend development, cloud computing, database management, and API design. I have worked extensively with Python, TypeScript, Java, C++, and Rust, designing a plethora of scalable systems. Not only am I passionate about utilizing my skills to build impactful solutions, but I am also pursuing a Master’s Degree in Computer Science with a specialization in Machine Learning from Georgia Tech, deepening my knowledge and positioning myself at the forefront of the tech industry.

I have consistently sought to merge my technical skills with leadership, successfully managing teams and projects that improved operational efficiency and reduced costs. Whether it’s engineering management or software development, my aim is to create value, drive innovation, and elevate productivity through well-executed solutions. As I continue to grow and evolve in my career, I am committed to using my diverse skill set to drive meaningful change and deliver lasting impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated on a confidential geospatial data visualization project that is powered by time-series geospatial JSON data with customizability and playback capability.
• Led efforts in data validation and preprocessing to ensure accuracy, consistency, and usability of large and complex datasets for real-time rendering and visualization of any industrial setting.
• Contributing to Agile workflows with daily standups and biweekly sprints; using Git and Linear to coordinate development with teammates and maintain a well-documented version-controlled codebase.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: Virginia Beach, Virginia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Leading the development of a fully responsive website using PHP, JavaScript, and SQL, projected to reduce page load times by 30% and increase user engagement by 20%.
- Managing database integration, ensuring 100% uptime and seamless access to educational tools, following Agile methodologies with sprint-based progress reviews.
- Contributed to the development of the API and logic for Propel, a natural language processing tool that helps students improve email writing by analyzing content and providing AI-driven suggestions for fixes using Spacy for machine learning. The tool's backend, built with Flask and Python, is in the process of being integrated into the website’s front end.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
- Conducts daily maintenance and updates for Atlantic Fleet ship logistics databases, managing data for nearly 80 ships and processing approximately 30 updates daily. Leverages Azure Databricks and Python to clean, transform, and combine data for optimized logistical support and mission readiness in accordance with ETL processes.
- Manages QlikView Advana dashboards, integrating classified and unclassified ship data to produce automated visualizations for the Admiral. The data for the visualizations is updated daily and a monthly report provides critical insights into ship maintenance and logistics, empowering informed decisions.
- Utilizes Python, including libraries like Pandas and NumPy, to analyze and process over 500,000 data points monthly of ship data on both classified and unclassified networks. Implements data engineering techniques to ensure the accuracy and consistency of complex datasets, transforming raw data into actionable insights for high-ranking officers.

positions.title: Nuclear Engineering Manager
positions.locationName: Newport News, Virginia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Led a team of 16 electricians and mechanics responsible for the maintenance of critical ship systems, including the Local Area Network, Reactor Monitoring systems, Reactor Controls systems, and associated peripherals. Spearheaded the development and implementation of 7 comprehensive technical training programs, resulting in 80% increase in departmental proficiency in networking and software computing.
- Utilized Agile methodologies such as scrum and sprints to manage the division’s workflow and deliver timely updates on system maintenance and training progress. Participated in daily stand-ups to ensure task coordination and successful completion of projects.
- Oversaw reactor plant testing and collaborated with Newport News Shipyard engineers, ensuring successful receipt, initial testing, and Navy approval of 50+ nuclear systems vital for activating two reactor plants. Prioritized safety by supervising 500+ preventative/corrective maintenance evolutions and test procedures for personnel and equipment.

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description: I attended and graduated from Naval Nuclear Power Training Command and Nuclear Power Training Unit to be fully trained as a Nuclear Officer for the U.S. Navy.

positions.title: Information Systems Operation Manager
positions.description:
- Oversaw end-to-end operations as the ship's Key Management Infrastructure (KMI) Operations Manager, managing the receipt, inventory, and distribution of 300+ cryptographic keys and devices. Led a team of 21 Information Technicians in utilizing Agile methodologies, including daily stand-ups and sprints, to ensure efficient and error-free operations of cryptographic devices and systems.
- Facilitated the timely and error-free delivery of over 2000 classified and unclassified communications by coordinating effectively with the 7th Fleet Admiral Communications Staff
- Ensured the safety of navigation during 700+ hours of ship operations, including underway replenishments, dockings, anchorages, and sea-based launch and recovery operations for small boats and helicopters, achieving a flawless safety record.

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description: I attended and graduated with honors at the United States Naval Academy with a major in Chemistry with a focus in Biochemistry. Upon graduation in May 2018, I attended Basic Division Officer School in San Diego, CA until August of 2018.

positions.title: Nuclear Electronics' Technician
positions.locationName: Goose Creek, South Carolina, United States
positions.description:
- Selected to be a Nuclear Electronics' Technician (ET).
- Enlisted Nuclear Schooling: top 3 GPAs amongst a class of over 300 ETs.
- Selected to attend the United States Naval Academy (USNA) to commission as a Naval Officer.

positions.title: Kohl's Retail Associate
positions.locationName: South Plainfield, New Jersey, United States
positions.description: During my brief time with Kohl's, I excelled in every task I was assigned.  My department always received recognition for best customer assistance, area cleanliness, and overall knowledge of all products.  My customer interaction skills enabled me to work in customer service, which was reserved for veteran employees.  Due to my outstanding performance at Kohl's, I was offered to work in management in my short time with the company.  Unfortunately, I had already committed to join the Navy in April of 2013 so I had to reluctantly reject the offer.  During my entire time at Kohl's, I was also taking classes at Middlesex County College part-time.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Culture · Leadership and Teamwork · Communication · User Requirements

positions.title: Verizon Call Center Sales Representative
positions.locationName: South Plainfield, New Jersey, United States
positions.description: This was my first job out of high school, which I graduated from in June of 2012.  Although I was their youngest employee, my exceptional social aptitude got my foot in the door into my first job as a phone sales representative.  My ability to speak Spanish helped me excel since I was able to receive sales from a whole other set of clients that most of my counterparts were unable to.  I left as early as I did to start part-time college classes at Middlesex County College; thus, I was off to find a job that was less demanding.

projects.title: Barter Hive
projects.description:
Developed an online social media platform with a focus on facilitating buying and selling, while incorporating key social media features. Implemented user authentication, posting, friend management, and real-time messaging functionality.
•	Used Python Flask and SQLAlchemy to develop a robust backend, creating APIs and managing database interactions with PostgreSQL.
•	Developed the frontend using JavaScript React, ensuring a user-friendly interface with clear and maintainable code.
•	Integrated Socket.IO into both frontend and backend, enabling real-time messaging capabilities for seamless user communication.
•	Designed and implemented Continuous Integration and Continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Render, automating testing and deployment, following Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices to maintain code quality.
•	Built a microservice architecture to handle user authentication, messaging, and post management independently, improving scalability and fault tolerance.
•	GitHub Repository: https://github.com/NomadLyfe/barter-hive
